IMPLEMENTATION GUIDE

Build and run ATLAS.

Start with the runnable ride flow. Use the linked files, API contracts and acceptance checks to extend it with a coding agent.

Open runnable source ↗Machine-readable specKafka event schema

01 / START

Run the full demo stack

Use Docker Compose for PostgreSQL and Kafka. The model setup trains on CPU and stores versioned artifacts before serving starts.

git clone --branch architecture-explorer --single-branch https://github.com/FUllSCIPTS/ATLAS.git
cd ATLAS/architecture-explorer/starter
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose exec -T gateway python -m tests.smoke

Open Passenger app and Driver app after startup. Book, accept, pick up and complete a ride.

The starter also includes a Python-only SQLite quickstart. Local run instructions

02 / TRAIN AND SERVE

Run the ML pipeline

Demand LSTM
Train on ordered counts and predict the next five-minute count per zone.
Acceptance model
Return a logistic regression probability for each driver from distance and speed.
Anomaly model
Use Isolation Forest to flag unusual telemetry and log it with the offer.
RL policy
Learn from completed rides, evaluate a versioned candidate, then explicitly approve or roll it back.

Training and policy commands ↗

03 / VERIFY

Know when it works

  1. A retried booking key returns the same trip and emits one booking event.
  2. Only the offered driver can accept. The trip reaches completed in order.
  3. The recorded offer shows a model version, forecast, acceptance score and anomaly flag.
  4. Completion creates one experience record. The RL approval gate and rollback work.

The starter uses demo accounts and synthetic training data. Real riders require production identity, GPS and routing, re-matching, payments, and evaluation on representative data.
